description: Safely checks account status, searches E-Hentai or ExHentai, inspects opaque gallery references, and reads Cloud Favorites or local history without exposing private URLs or credentials.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Required action enum: account.status, search, gallery.detail, favorites.list, history.list.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search text for search or favorites.list.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional gallery category key for search.

parameters.name: galleryRef
parameters.description: Opaque short-lived reference returned by search/favorites/history.
